markets.title: Brent Crude Hits $70 a Barrel as Trump Ramps Up Iran Threats
markets.description: Brent crude futures hit $70 a barrel for the first time since September after US President Donald Trump warned Iran to make a nuclear deal or face military strikes.

markets.title: Saudi’s Manara Sounds Out Firms Over Push Into Metals Trading
markets.description: Saudi Arabia’s state-controlled metals and mining vehicle is in talks with some of the world’s biggest commodity houses over a push into trading, as the kingdom expands its presence in global supply chains.

markets.title: Deutsche Bank Vows Research Independence After Bessent Call
markets.description: Deutsche Bank AG has no plans to curtail the independence of its research after a controversial report prompted Chief Executive Officer Christian Sewing to call US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.

markets.title: Total Ends Five-Year Halt on $20 Billion Mozambique LNG Plan
markets.description: TotalEnergies SE formally restarted construction of a $20 billion liquefied natural gas project in Mozambique, ending a nearly five-year delay in developing one of Africa’s biggest-ever investments.

markets.title: Crypto’s ‘Digital Gold’ Myth Exposed as Traders Pivot to Metals
markets.description: Bitcoin’s “digital gold” promise is unraveling as traders forgo the token for surging metals, hurting a narrative that once defined the asset’s macro appeal.

markets.title: BlackRock, Partners Group Debut Private-Asset Account for Wealth
markets.description: BlackRock Inc. and Partners Group Holding AG launched the first joint private-markets investment of their partnership aimed at grabbing a slice of the trillions of dollars sitting in the hands of wealthy individuals.

markets.title: Stocks Rise as Tech Megacaps Step Up AI Spending: Markets Wrap
markets.description: US stock futures advanced as technology megacaps unleashed further spending to build out the infrastructure that powers artificial intelligence. Gold and silver hit new highs.

markets.title: Indonesia Stocks Pare Worst Rout Since 1998 on Reform Promise
markets.description: Indonesian equities staged a late-session recovery from their deepest two-day rout in nearly three decades, as regulators rushed to implement measures aimed at averting a potential downgrade by index compiler MSCI Inc.

markets.title: China’s Metals Mania Sends Copper Soaring Past $14,000 a Ton
markets.description: Copper surged by the most in more than 16 years as metals extended a dramatic start to the year fueled by a wave of intense speculative trading in China.

markets.title: Royal Caribbean Jumps as Accelerating Demand Spurs Fleet Growth
markets.description: Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd. shares jumped as demand for cruise holidays keeps accelerating, which could see the liner add as many as six additional ships to its fleet.

markets.title: VSE Agrees to Acquire Precision Aviation in $2 Billion Deal
markets.description: VSE Corp., a provider of aftermarket parts and services to the aviation industry, agreed to buy closely held Precision Aviation Group for about $2.025 billion in a cash-and-stock deal.

markets.title: International Paper to Split Into Two Listed Companies
markets.description: International Paper Co. plans to break up and spin off its European packaging operations.

markets.title: Indian LNG Buyers and Global Producers Locked in Game of Chicken
markets.description: There’s a wave of fuel supply coming online around the world, but buyers in India are waiting until the price is right.

markets.title: Tech's AI Spending Boosts Stocks; Oil Rises on Trump Iran Threats | Bloomberg Brief 1/29/2026
markets.description: US equity futures gain as large tech firms including Meta announce plans to spend more on AI. SAP and Microsoft lag as their cloud businesses disappoint. The dollar weakens amid debasement fears while gold extends its record rally. Oil prices rise as President Trump warns Iran of military strikes if a nuclear deal is not reached soon. Marija Veitmane of State Street and Joel Kulina of Wedbush discuss this earnings season. (Source: Bloomberg)

markets.title: Bets on Surprise ECB Cut in 2026 Aim for 12-Fold Return
markets.description: Traders are using options to bet on European Central Bank policymakers surprising markets by delivering a quarter-point interest-rate cut at some point this year.

markets.title: Deutsche Bank Raid Casts Cloud Over Record Year for Profit
markets.description: Deutsche Bank AG closed out a record year for profit with higher trading income and a new share buyback, a boost to Chief Executive Officer Christian Sewing a day after a raid of its Frankfurt offices raked up memories of the lender’s past troubles.

markets.title: Emerging-Market Assets Pause as Dollar Steadies After Fed Hold
markets.description: Benchmark indexes for emerging-market stocks and currencies paused after a five-day advance as the Federal Reserve signaled caution on interest-rate cuts and Indonesia’s stock market endured its worst selloff in two decades.

markets.title: Dollar Decline Resumes as Debasement Fears Increase
markets.description: The dollar weakened Thursday as Bloomberg’s gauge of the US currency slipped 0.3%, while precious metals such as gold and silver extended their record-breaking rallies. The return of the so-called debasement trade outweighed Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s affirmation of the strong-greenback policy. Tyler Kendall reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

markets.title: There’s a World-Wide Bull Market, Says Edward Yardeni
markets.description: “It’s kind of a bull market in everything,” says Edward Yardeni, chief investment strategist at Yardeni Research, as he sees strength building in emerging markets along with resilience in the US and global economies. (Source: Bloomberg)

markets.title: Metals Mania Is Gripping Investors Around the World
markets.description: Silver is up 64% this year as investors shift away from the dollar and sovereign bonds.

technology.title: Caterpillar Earnings Beat Boosted by AI Data Center Power Demand
technology.description: Caterpillar Inc. got an earnings boost from selling power generation equipment to AI data centers in its fourth quarter, helping drive quarterly results that topped Wall Street’s expectations.

technology.title: Robinhood to Vie for Key Retail Role in Mega SpaceX IPO
technology.description: Robinhood Markets Inc., the upstart broker credited with getting young people hooked on trading, is vying for a key role in SpaceX’s blockbuster initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.

technology.title: Fiat, Toyota Tycoons Back Startup RobCo in $100 Million Round
technology.description: RobCo, a German startup that makes robots for use in manufacturing, has raised $100 million in financing from investors including the family behind Fiat parent Stellantis NV and Exor NV, and a billionaire Toyota dealer.

technology.title: Zuckerberg Backs Up the Brink’s Truck (Again)
technology.description: Meta’s CEO continues to boost spending for AI

technology.title: Comcast Profit Beats Estimates Despite Broadband Decline
technology.description: Comcast Corp. reported revenue and profit in the fourth quarter that met or surpassed Wall Street expectations, even as it continued to lose cable TV and internet customers.

technology.title: Lloyds Expects £100 Million Boost from AI Spend in 2026
technology.description: Lloyds Banking Group Plc expects to see a £100 million ($138 million) benefit from using artificial intelligence this year as the bank continues investing heavily in technology.

technology.title: Zuckerberg, Musk Vie for AI Supremacy With $155 Billion Splurge
technology.description: Meta Platforms Inc. will double capital spending to as much as $135 billion this year, an all-in bet on artificial intelligence as the US tech giants battle it out for supremacy in the next wave of technological advancements.

technology.title: Amazon Found ‘High Volume’ Of Child Sex Abuse Material in AI Training Data
technology.description: The tech giant reported hundreds of thousands of cases of suspected child sexual abuse material, but won’t say where it came from

technology.title: SAP Falls as Cloud Backlog Miss Sparks AI Competition Fears
technology.description: SAP SE shares fell the most in more than five years as current cloud backlog in the fourth quarter slipped to a level that Chief Executive Officer Christian Klein previously said would be a “disappointment,” adding to worries of how artificial intelligence will disrupt the software industry.

technology.title: Memory Maker Kioxia Names New CEO to Navigate AI Chip Boom
technology.description: Japanese flash memory maker Kioxia Holdings Corp. is promoting Executive Vice President Hiroo Oota to chief executive officer and president in a move aimed at expanding its presence in the booming memory chip market.

technology.title: Apple Results to Give Clues on How Hard Memory Prices Are Biting
technology.description: Apple Inc.’s stock is taking a hit as investors try to assess how much rapidly rising memory prices are eating into its bottom line. Investors will get a peek when the iPhone maker reports its earnings after the close Thursday.

technology.title: Ocado’s Canadian Partner Closes Warehouse in Fresh Setback
technology.description: Ocado Group Plc’s Canadian partner will close its automated warehouse in Calgary due to slower-than-expected growth, the latest setback for the British online grocery delivery company.

technology.title: Nvidia, Others in Talks for OpenAI Funding, Information Says
technology.description: Nvidia Corp., Microsoft Corp. and Amazon.com Inc. are in discussions to invest as much as $60 billion in OpenAI as part of a major new funding round, the Information reported, citing people familiar with the talks.

technology.title: China Executes 11 People Linked to Cyberscam Centers in Myanmar

technology.title: STMicro Sales Outlook Beats Estimates on Chip Recovery
technology.description: STMicroelectronics NV, a chip supplier for Tesla Inc. and Apple Inc., forecast first-quarter revenue that beat analysts’ estimates after demand from consumer electronics customers showed signs of recovery at the end of last year.

technology.title: Mitsubishi Electric Backs Startup to Push Into AI Factory Robots
technology.description: Mitsubishi Electric Corp. is backing construction-tech startup Akari Inc., the latest in a sector-wide quest for knowhow to fully automate factories and train robots to react to different situations.

technology.title: Nvidia CEO Says Chinese Government Yet to Approve H200 Imports
technology.description: Nvidia Corp. hasn’t yet received any orders from Chinese customers for its H200 AI chips as Beijing is still deciding whether to allow imports of the US firm’s components, according to its chief executive officer.

technology.title: Advantest’s Nikkei 225 Weight Cut Looms After 15% Rally
technology.description: A potential cut to Advantest Corp.’s weighting in Japan’s Nikkei 225 Stock Average could drive passive selling as index funds rebalance.

technology.title: South Korea Says US Trade Friction Unrelated to Coupang Probe
technology.description: South Korea’s top diplomat said Donald Trump’s recent threat to raise tariffs on goods from its US ally is not connected to an ongoing investigation into a high-profile data breach at e-commerce company Coupang Inc.

technology.title: LG Energy Targets Data Center Energy Needs as EV Outlook Dims

politics.description: China indicated that an anti-graft purge roiling the People’s Liberation Army won’t impede its plans for eventually taking control of self-run Taiwan, while also brushing aside doubts about the effectiveness of its military in the wake of the ouster of top generals.

politics.title: Trump Tells Iran Time Running Out & AI in Focus for Tech Earnings | Daybreak Europe 1/29/2026
politics.description: Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. Live from London, we set the agenda for your day, catching you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia. And we'll tell you what matters for investors in Europe, giving you insight before trading begins. On today's show, President Trump has warned Iran to make a nuclear deal with the US or face military strikes even worse than last June, increasing pressure on the regime and propelling oil prices higher. Meta beat estimates, with its strong online ads business helping fund record AI investment. Meanwhile, Microsoft fell postmarket as underwhelming cloud sales took the shine off its capex spending. Deutsche Bank reported fourth-quarter fixed-income and currency revenue that beat estimates. Today's guests: Deutsche Bank CFO James Von Moltke & ABB CEO Morten Wierod. (Source: Bloomberg)

politics.title: Xi Says China Weighing Visa-Free UK Access After Meeting Starmer

economics.title: Ukraine Delivers Rate Cut After Shoring Up Wartime Financing

economics.description: India’s government predicted the economy could expand more than 7% in the coming financial year, offering an optimistic outlook at a time of heightened uncertainty for global trade.

economics.description: Sweden’s central bank held borrowing costs steady for a fourth month and stuck with its forecast for no change until next year as evidence builds that an economic recovery will be strong enough to keep inflation close to its target.
